messages:
Mia: Heads-up — we’re rolling webinar launch posts tomorrow at 9am PT. Need final asset pick for X and LinkedIn and who’s owning inbound lead routing. Quick sync?
Cam: I can own the X thread + reply cadence. Lia, can you confirm creatives?
Lia: Yep — final assets in Drive: /Marketing/LaunchAssets/webinar_v2/ (file names: webinar1-card.png, webinar1-gif.mp4, webinar-copy-v3.md). Shared access to the sheet: https://docs.example.com/sheets/launch-schedule
Jordan: For LinkedIn, we should A/B headline: "Reduce inference cost by 3x" vs "Predictable LLM inference at scale". Which do we want to test first?
Mia: Let’s lead with the performance angle (Reduce inference cost by 3x) on post 1, and try the predictability headline on the follow-up thread. Add an experiment tag so we can track.
Ryan: Routing note — all webinar signups go to HubSpot list "WL-Webinar-Launch" and then webhook to SalesOps. I’ll add the flow and a Slack notify to #sales-inbound. Can someone drop the webhook URL into the sheet?
Cam: Posting cadence plan (draft):
```
09:00 PT — X short post + link to signup
09:05 PT — X thread (3 tweets) w/asset gif
09:15 PT — LinkedIn post (company) w/CTA
12:00 PT — Engagement follow-up (X replies + 5 curated DMs)
```
Mia: That looks good. Lia — can you export the GIF at 1200x675 and add an alt text? Also need 2 versions of the hero image: 1 for X, 1 for LinkedIn crop.
Lia: On it. Targeting uploads by EOD today. Also uploading messaging matrix in copy doc: webinar-copy-v3.md (section "social_variants").
Jordan: For engagement follow-ups, create short templated replies: 1) thanks + link, 2) question probe (how do you use inference today?), 3) ask for demo. I’ll draft them.
Ryan: Confirmed webhook added to sheet. I’ll set a canned Slack alert: "New lead — webinar signup" to #sales-inbound. @Cam please confirm you want those routed to you as well.
Cam: Yes, route copies to me. I’ll triage high-intent replies and flag to AE.
DeployBot: Reminder — scheduled post tasks created in SocialQueue for 4071234567-POST. Use /social sync to see status.
Mia: Great progress. Last ask — can we add a tiny experiment to vary the first tweet CTA ("Sign up" vs "Watch demo") and track CTR in the sheet? If yes, add a column for variant and we’ll map UTM params.
Lia: Added "cta_variant" column and export of UTM templates.
Jordan: Drafted reply templates and added to the copy doc. Ready for review.
Mia: Perfect — final review at 5pm PT. If all green, we go live tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
